instructorHourlyCost.rationale: BLS OEWS May 2022 Chicago-Naperville-Elgin mean wage for fitness trainers and instructors $26.05/hour x about 1.3 benefits/overhead x about 1.15 wage growth to 2026 = about $39, rounded to $40. Upper bound allows a certified-instructor premium. SF's $60 was an assumption, not OEWS, so the SF-to-Chicago gap mixes method and place.

sources.title: OEWS May 2022: 39-9031 Fitness Trainers and Aerobics Instructors
